configurations.name: backend
configurations.comment: Runs against SQLite by default so `preview` works with zero infra (ADR-0006). Set DATABASE_URL in the environment to use Postgres instead, or use `docker compose up` for the full stack. Migrations run on every start (idempotent).
runtimeArgs: cd backend && export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-sqlite+aiosqlite:///./dev.db}" && .venv/bin/alembic upgrade head && exec .venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
